topics.disposition: Renamed to Goods and Services Tax v1.0; same country/job.
Legacy single heading replaced with the nine required sections.

topics.old_text: Sierra Leone levies a single-rate Goods and Services Tax (GST), a VAT-style consumption tax introduced in 2010 and administered by the NRA under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2009. There is no separate sales tax.
topics.destination: Who this applies to / Sources: Not yet confirmed
topics.disposition: 2010 history and no-separate-sales-tax claim explicitly held; rate/authority facts use primary cited rules.

topics.old_text: - **Standard GST rate** — 15 percent  _([Goods and Services Tax Act 2009](https://www.pwc.co.za/en/publications/vat-in-africa/sierra-leone-overview.html))_
topics.disposition: 15% ordinary taxable rate retained with exemptions/zero-rate and GST-exclusive conditions.

topics.old_text: - **GST on imports** — 15 percent (applied to imported goods and services for local use)  _([Goods and Services Tax Act 2009](https://www.pwc.co.za/en/publications/vat-in-africa/sierra-leone-overview.html))_
topics.destination: Rates / The base ss25-26 / Cross-border s24
topics.disposition: Goods import classification/value retained; blanket imported-services claim corrected to conditional reverse-charge/digital tests.

topics.old_text: - **Zero-rated supplies** — 0 percent (Exports and certain supplies are zero-rated (approx — confirm))  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
topics.disposition: Zero-rate goods exports/stores retained with external-delivery evidence, not every foreign-customer service.

topics.old_text: - **Exempt supplies** — Basic foodstuffs, financial services, education, medical services and similar items are exempt (approx — confirm)  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
topics.disposition: Specific2023entry conditions replace generic categories;2026renewable/HS/numbering conflicts explicitly held.

topics.old_text: - **Registration threshold** — 100,000 NLe (Annual taxable turnover of NLe 100,000 or more (approx — confirm))  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
topics.disposition: Old100000 corrected to2024Le500000 replacement; allturnover and compulsory tests distinguished.

topics.old_text: - **Filing frequency** — Monthly GST returns (approx — confirm)  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
topics.disposition: Monthly statutory period plus otherprescribedperiod condition retained.

topics.old_text: - **Return and payment deadline** — By the last working day of the month following the tax period (approx — confirm)  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
- **Input tax credit** — Registered persons may credit input GST against output GST on taxable supplies  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_

- **Reverse charge on imported services** — Recipients of services from non-resident suppliers self-account for GST under the reverse-charge mechanism (approx — confirm)  _(Goods and Services Tax Act 2009)_
